# Template-Projekte v1.0.2

This patch release restores the complete generated-profile contract and publishes the post-v1.0.0 security and supply-chain controls on a new immutable release commit.

## Highlights

- Feature queries remain type-safe when a generated profile intentionally omits `backend`, including `web-only` and `desktop-local`.
- All five profile presets are required to pass lifecycle verification, quality, tests, and their applicable build checks on one commit.
- GitHub Actions and dependency maintenance remain governed through immutable Action pins, CodeQL, dependency review, CODEOWNERS, protected release tags, and controlled Dependabot grouping.
- Browser smoke tests, automated accessibility checks, coverage thresholds, bundle budgets, and release-strict quality enforcement are active.

## Published evidence

The release publisher runs only after tag-triggered Release Validation has completed successfully. It verifies successful Core CI, Desktop CI, PostgreSQL Integration, Profile Matrix, Security, and Release Validation runs on the exact release SHA before publishing:

- a tracked-source ZIP generated from the immutable commit;
- the tested web ZIP;
- mode-preserving unsigned Linux and macOS `tar.gz` verification bundles plus the validated Windows ZIP;
- an SPDX JSON dependency SBOM;
- a machine-readable exact-SHA workflow evidence manifest;
- aggregate SHA-256 checksums;
- tag-context build-provenance and SBOM attestations for the byte-identical web ZIP; and
- a native immutable-release attestation covering the tag, commit, and complete published asset set.

The publisher requires a non-bypassable `v*` tag ruleset before draft promotion and can safely resume by read-only verification if the exact native immutable release already exists. The final GitHub Release notes append the immutable commit and exact workflow run-attempt links dynamically. Those identifiers cannot be embedded in the commit whose hash and CI runs they describe.

## Limitations

Desktop packages remain unsigned verification builds: Windows is not Authenticode-signed, macOS is not signed or notarized, and Linux packages carry no distribution signature. This repository is a reusable master template, not a finished end-user product. Product authentication, domain behavior, production persistence, telemetry, privacy policy, support, signing, and deployment remain responsibilities of derived products.

The existing `v1.0.0` and `v1.0.1` tags remain unchanged. `v1.0.1` is a tag-only incomplete candidate whose Profile Matrix failed and which has no GitHub Release; `v1.0.2` is its governed replacement.
